## 2-3. Causality (windows ending at or before the window above)

| seq | end_frame | windows | code_level_identical | e2e_windows_changed | e2e_base_features_changed | e2e_ctx_features_changed |

| fall-06 | 100 | 15 | True | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| adl-07 | 95 | 14 | True | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| fall-14 | 60 | 7 | True | 3 | 5 | 3 |

code_level_identical: the feature code reads no frame after the window end. e2e_*: changes caused by the shared preprocess, which interpolates gaps of at most 15 frames (0.5 s) using the next valid frame; it affects base and context features alike.
